batch.description: Use the bare batch id such as "7"; the gate also accepts legacy <run>-batch-<id> labels on frozen artifacts.

findings.description: Confirmed or suspected defects the reader was not licensed to edit. Repaired findings belong in the markdown report and byte-diff route, not here.

id.description: Exact existing item ID or page ID of the defective subject. Do not invent a finding label; the routing tool assigns the finding's obligation ID.

consumer_id.description: For a published or another-batch current-run dependency, the exact assigned item whose deps/justified_by closure reaches it; otherwise null.

observed_source.description: Set null unless an in-run-dependency finding can bind the exact observed bytes. pre means the producer's immutable pre-reader snapshot; current means the source bytes remain current at split. Never claim corrected current bytes were the old observed defect.
